warehouse/30103.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Only mules and fools should be loaded with heavy and nonessential packs. Why not deposit your items in this safe and affordable branch of the Iron Gate Guild? I swear by Maphr that we will protect your valuable with our lives...

warehouse/30103-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Huh, I teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers and Bounty Hunters only. You should look for a Master who can teach you some skills. If you are an Artisan, go to a Blacksmith.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: The Scriptures of Knowledge? Ah, what a strange book! I got it from that Drunkard Triff as payment for his debt... Is it as valuable as he said? Well the money that he owes me wasn't that much, anyway... 1,000 Adena, I believe...?
when: state STARTED; has items 2705; lacks items 2710,2714,2707

links.text: "Please give me the Scriptures of Knowledge: Volume II."

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-05.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Have you forgotten the terms already? First you must bring me the Crystal of Purity ! Then we will talk about that scripture thing.
when: state STARTED; has items 2705,2710,2714,2707; lacks items 2714,2707

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-06.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Wow, this is indeed the Crystal of Purity! How did you find such a precious thing so quickly? You are more skillful than I had expected. Oh, well, a man should keep his word. Here is the Scripture: Volume II . Take good care of it!
when: state STARTED; has items 2705,2710,2714,2707; lacks items 2710,2707; !(hasQuestItems(player, VALKONS_REQUEST) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, CRYSTAL_OF_PURITY2, SCRIPTURE_CHAPTER_2))

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-07.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: I understand that you are trying to acquire the whole collection of scriptures? Well, I doubt that you can find them so easily? Keep trying, young one!
when: state STARTED; has items 2705,2710,2714,2707; lacks items 2710,2714; !(hasQuestItems(player, VALKONS_REQUEST) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, CRYSTAL_OF_PURITY2, SCRIPTURE_CHAPTER_2)); !(hasQuestItems(player, CRYSTAL_OF_PURITY2) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, VALKONS_REQUEST, SCRIPTURE_CHAPTER_2))

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: How long will you be an apprentice? Don't you have any ambition? I hope you are not under the impression that you have reached a comfortable level. Shouldn't you work harder and challenge the Trial of the Guildsman ? You won't be a true member of Dwarven society until you p…

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-03.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: How long will you be an apprentice? Don't you have any ambition? I hope you are not under the impression that you have reached a comfortable level. Now listen to me carefully. I shall tell you about Dwarven education.
when: state CREATED; NOT level < 35; ((player.getClassId() == ClassId.artisan) || (player.getClassId() == ClassId.scavenger))

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: I have been in charge of the promotion test of the Dwarf union members for the last 10 years. Among all Dwarf apprentices, only those who pass this test are accepted as full members of Dwarven society. This may not be clear to you since you are not a Dwarf, but within our s…

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-07.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: It is said that Altran was once a kind man, but perhaps due to his age he has become much more irritable these days. They say that his arthritis is making him a crooked old man...

links.text: Do you know of a good remedy for arthritis?

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-08.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: How is your work proceeding, young fellow? How is the making of the 7 Journeyman Gem going? You should complete it soon so you can advance beyond an apprentice. Good luck!
when: state STARTED; has items 3122; lacks items 3120; getQuestItemsCount(player, JOURNEYMAN_RING) < 7

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-09.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: You have made all the rings. Thank you for your trouble. So, did you learn anything from the test?
when: state STARTED; has items 3122; lacks items 3120; !getQuestItemsCount(player, JOURNEYMAN_RING) < 7

links.text: "I learned the mind attitude and virtues that one should possess as a faithful union member."
"I learned how to fawn upon the authorities of the guild and ways to bribe them."

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Hey, youngster! You expect me to give it to you for free? What about the debt? Would you care to pay for that instead?

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-03.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: So, you will pay the debt? Hey since I loaned that man 1,000 Adena... How long has it been? Let me see... Yes, that was 10 years ago, 10 years! Do you know how much interest is drawn from that? If you compute the compound interest, that would be... Let's say, 100,000 Adena!…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30103-04.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Good! You are a good fellow. Now listen to me carefully. I have heard of a very precious crystal, what was its name, yes, that's right, it is called the Purifying Crystal . I have heard that only one person can make it. If you will bring me one of those, I shall gladly give…

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-04.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Dwarven apprentices will work in the Strip Mine to strengthen their bodies and spirits, as well as learning to protect their own bodies. When they complete basic training they return to the Dwarven Village and accumulate experience while assisting the Elders of the guilds w…

links.text: I will take the Test of the Guildsman.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-05.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: First you must pay the registration fee. The amount will be 2,000 Adena . All fees received are used to support the technical development of the guild and sponsoring Artisans.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-05a.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: First you must pay the registration fee. The amount will be 2,000 adena . All fees received are used to support the technical development of the guild and sponsoring Artisans.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-05b.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: How embarassing for you! You should have known to bring some money with you... Come back when you get 2,000 Adena.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-06.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Good! You must first take this badge. It is a mark that lets others know that you are in the midst of taking the Trial of the Guildsman. Many Blacksmiths and Warehouse Chiefs will help you when they see your badge. The content of the test is quite simple. It consists of mak…

links.text: Do you have any more advice for me?

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-06a.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Hints? You want to learn the short way through even before trying to solve it out by patiently working hard... Tsk tsk... A young Dwarf shouldn't be like that!

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-06b.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Hmm... What nerves you've got. Hints... Well, yes I just came across one. I heard that Altran used to be a kind man, but perhaps because of his aging, he seems to be a bit fastidious these days. Some say that it is because of the arthritis... Whatever the reason may be, he …

links.text: Where can I find a Mandragora Berry?

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-06c.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Must everything be spelled out for you? Some things you must discover on your own!

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-06d.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Very well! First, take this insignia, which signifies that you are performing the Trial of the Guildsman. Many blacksmiths and senior warehouse keepers will assist you when they see it. The trial itself is very straightforward. You must make 7 Journeyman Rings . Don't be fo…

links.text: Ask if he has any more hints to give you.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-07a.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Some say that the Mandragora Berry is helpful for the pain of arthritis... Yes, this would be an excellent gift to give him.

links.text: "Where can I find a Mandragora Berry?"

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-07b.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Hey, you! Do I have to tell you everything?! You can do such things for yourself!

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-07c.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Now let's see... Think about it! Where would be the best place to find a mandragora in the whole continent? There is a place in Dion called the Mandragora Farm.

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-09a.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Yes, yes, yes! Superb! You will make an excellent addition to our guild, and I perceive a bright future in store for you. Congratulations! You have successfully passed the Trial of the Guildsman, and I now award you the Mark of Guildsman . It will aid you when transfering t…

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30103-09b.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Valkon: Hmmph. With talk like that, you won't last very long or rise very high here, my friend. My advice is to learn to fake sincerity, and everything else will be easy. Understood? In any case, congratulations are in order. You have successfully passed the Trial of the Guildsman,…
